title: Structural Deposit Percent by Construction Stage — Design Studio Selections Option Deposits
content:
The structural deposit percent applied to the structural group (structural, electrical and plumbing lines) of a Design Studio Selections file's option deposit is set by the construction stage of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves:

| Construction stage on the Home Purchase Agreement | Structural deposit percent |
|---|---|
| Framing, drywall, finishes or complete | 100 percent |
| Foundation | 75 percent |
| Any other stage | The package's structural deposit percent |

**Package structural deposit percent (any other stage)**

| Package | Percent |
|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 100 |
| Studio Classic | 75 |
| Studio Select | 50 |
| Studio Designer | 50 |
| Studio Signature | 50 |
| Studio Atelier | 50 |

**Records read.** The current construction stage on the Home Purchase Agreement.

*Hypothetical cases:* a Studio Select file whose agreement shows foundation takes 75 percent; at framing, 100 percent; before construction starts, the package's 50 percent.
